title: Achiri conversation summarizer — compress old turns into persistent summary
description: When user exceeds 50 turns, oldest turns are lost. This sprint adds a local summarizer that extracts key facts from older turns into a compact summary file. The summary persists across sessions and is injected into the system prompt alongside the profile context. Zero LLM cost — pattern extraction.
source: auto — Achiri Phase 2A roadmap: memory subsystem enhancement
